'''Lianorm Swamp''' was a swamp on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It stretched over an area of thirty-four square miles and was located on the edge of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] and the foothills of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI" />

==History==
Millennia before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Elders (Naboo)/Legends|Elders]] built a monument within the Lianorm Swamp which was later considered a [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|sacred place]] by the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI" />

The city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] was located near the outskirts of the swamp and served as a meeting place and center of trade between the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and the Gungans.

[[File:Jar_Jar_meets_Jedi.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] meet [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] in the Lianorm Swamp.]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] landed its forces in the Lianorm Swamp during the invasion of Naboo.<ref name="ItWoSWEI" /> The swamp was taken over by the Trade Federation.<ref name="TPM" /> At this time, it served as the adopted homeland of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]],<ref name="ItWoSWEI" /> and it was from here that Binks led [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. After the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|Fall of Theed]], Trade Federation forces deployed in the Gungan Swamp to [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|raid]] Gungan villages. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] later went to the Gungan Sacred Place to meet [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] and finally form an alliance between the Gungans and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM" />

Around 32 BBY, [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] were organized in the region and the [[Lianorm Raceway]] was set up.<ref name="RR" />
